facts.value: The Global Office supports international exchange students and scholarship holders during their stay at Goethe University, from preparation to personal support on site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has important information and offers for international postdoctoral researchers, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial consultations to buddy programs, Goethe University offers services related to admissions, scholarships, residency rights, and more for a successful start in Frankfurt.
The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps students transition from study to profession successfully in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies, including preparatory and language courses, scholarships, assistance with housing, bureaucratic processes, financing, and integration.
Discover language offers and preparatory study options for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
